chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Faces a Second Heavenly Calamity in Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 458
chapter_meta_description: Niuxin Village is plunged into unnatural blackness as a second Heavenly Calamity strikes. Li Huowang and Zhuge Yuan debate the terrifying implications of back-to-back disasters.
og_title: The Sun Has Been Eaten in the Dao-Twisted World
og_description: A Heavenly Calamity hits just two years after the last one. Li Huowang stabilizes a panicked village while Zhuge Yuan warns of something rotten in the White Jade Capital.
twitter_title: Heavenly Calamity #2 in 2 Years? Something Is Very Wrong
twitter_description: The sky goes pitch black as a second Heavenly Calamity strikes the Dao-Twisted World. Li Huowang manages the chaos, but Zhuge Yuan’s unease signals a deeper cosmic fracture.

lore_anchors.definition: A global disaster caused by Simings fighting over control of the Dao, not a personal karmic tribulation.
Traditional Chinese folk explanation for solar eclipses; villagers once beat drums and gongs to scare the celestial dog away.
A government organization tasked with suppressing supernatural threats and Heavenly Calamities, though its integrity is increasingly suspect.
A well-read scholar able to observe and perceive hidden phenomena in the Dao-Twisted World.
The Mother of the Dipper, a powerful Siming whose previous appearance demonstrated reality-bending power on a cosmic scale.
A persistent hallucination of a Zuowandao trickster that taunts Li Huowang, often serving as a narrative echo of his own dark thoughts.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang stop the villagers from beating gongs?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He has seen a real Heavenly Calamity before and knows folk remedies don't work against a Siming-level disaster. His priority is order, not superstition.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the previous Heavenly Calamity?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The disappearance of decay—nothing in the world would rot or spoil. It led to the death of Abbess Jingxin.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Zhuge Yuan suspicious of the Supervisory Heavenly Office?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He believes they have violated ancestral laws by colluding with the Great Liang imperial family, which should have been forbidden.
